purpose: Implement and freeze the exact one-shot official Binance metadata capture needed for the X1 PIT lineage attempt already frozen by X1-002B. No network execution, market body, price, return, correlation or PnL access in this task.

request_classes.identity: Support announcement index pages categories 48 and 161
support/announcement/detail/<id> pages discovered only from bounded indexes
official API definition pages for response-schema pinning

frozen_network_attempt.redirects: must remain within binance.com allowed hosts

requirements: Implement one deterministic standard-library metadata capture tool matching the exact frozen request classes/caps. It must make no market-price/body requests and no websocket connections.

Every response must be captured with canonical requested URL, final URL, UTC request/response times, HTTP status, content type, ETag/Last-Modified when present, raw-response SHA256 and bounded raw-response bytes in task output.
Support announcement detail URLs may be discovered only from the bounded official category-index responses. Deduplicate exact IDs deterministically before fetching details.

Freeze canonical pagination/termination behavior for the two category indexes. Unknown pagination/schema, redirect outside allowed hosts or request/byte cap exhaustion must fail closed as SOURCE_INCOMPLETE, not expand search.

Produce a compact normalized candidate ledger for the existing offline resolver, but never manufacture completeness_attestation=OFFICIAL_IMMUTABLE_OR_AUDITABLE_COMPLETE. The capture tool may emit only evidence needed for a later Strategy Manager completeness decision.

Provide offline synthetic tests for URL allowlisting, redirect rejection, pagination termination, detail-ID extraction/deduplication, request/byte budgets, response hashing, capture manifest ordering and fail-closed unknown schema.
terminal_rule: Persist only the exact three allowed outputs, verify readback/hash and revalidate current main, then write one TERMINAL RECEIPT with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false. Stop. The intended successor after bounded manager review is one offline self-test, then exact one-shot T1 metadata capture if PASS.
